en: A vintage postcard depicting a lively European town square filled with market stalls and umbrellas. The square is surrounded by multi-story classical buildings with shops on the ground floor. In the middle of the square stands a prominent statue or monument with several figures. In the background, on a hill, there is a large clock tower (Uhrturm) overlooking the town. The postcard has the text 'Graz - Hauptplatz' printed on it.
